educational_overlay.purpose: Audits proposed involuntary employee terminations for legal risk, statutory severance compliance, notice periods, and discrimination claims.
educational_overlay.when_to_use: Prior to issuing termination notices, conducting performance-based exits, or implementing corporate restructuring.
educational_overlay.when_not_to_use: When an employee voluntarily resigns without dispute or grievance.
educational_overlay.prompt_template:
Review proposed termination of {{WORKER_STATUS}} with {{TENURE_YEARS}} years service on grounds of {{GROUND_FOR_EXIT}}.
Assess procedural fairness, statutory retrenchment compensation requirements, notice period dues, and gratuity obligations.
Identify wrongful termination risks under applicable industrial and shops & establishment legislation.
Mark unverified factors with [VERIFY].
educational_overlay.fictional_scenario: A technology company seeks to terminate a senior software engineer after a 30-day Performance Improvement Plan without conducting a domestic inquiry.
educational_overlay.sample_output:
### Termination Risk Assessment: MODERATE-HIGH
- **Procedural Gap**: PIP documentation lacks clear objective benchmarks.
- **Statutory Dues**: Gratuity mandatory after 5 years (not triggered at 4 years); 1 month notice or pay in lieu required.
guardrails: Never terminate an employee on medical leave or maternity leave.
verification_checklist: Confirm compliance with Industrial Disputes Act retrenchment notice provisions if classified as workman.
Verify release agreement includes valid waiver of claims.
educational_overlay.ai_risk_warning: Local Shops and Commercial Establishments Acts vary significantly across Indian states.
